# Real-source quality fixtures

These minimal, manually transcribed excerpts were checked on 2026-10-11. They
exercise attribution and missing-evidence behavior without network requests.
They are not complete publications, a live provider test, or a current legal
assessment. Derived negative scenarios in tests are deliberately modified
inputs; they do not claim the source said those things.

- [ResNet, arXiv v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/1512.03385): title, authors, year, DOI,
  and one abstract sentence. The fixture adapter label `arxiv-fixture` does not
  add a production literature provider.
- [AI Act, original text](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A32024R1689):
  a short fragment of Article 1(1). This snapshot does not track amendments,
  obligations, or application dates. Original law and current applicability
  must be checked separately.
